_help: Key each entry by an exact spell NAME. Value is either an array of Item UUIDs (just the effects) or an object: { window: "persistent"|"instant" (which tab opens after clicking Place), effects: [Item UUIDs], mode: "inside"|"once", duration: rounds (0=unlimited), durationMode: "combat"|"caster", terrain: "difficult"|"greater" (optional, makes the area difficult/greater difficult terrain on the token ruler; walking only) }. Effects are PF2e spell-effect Item UUIDs (grab them from any effect, e.g. Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.<id>).
